_comment: The live podium ceremony (Podium.cs + PodiumScene.cs, 2.3.0). Edit with any text editor. Events: captions and graphics by second ({N1} {N2} {N3} the real names, {N1U} in capitals, {GAP2} {GAP3} the gap to the winner, {TRACK} the track, {GREET} a greeting by the time of day). Lower 1-3 shows that place's lower third, -1 hides it; Champ = CAMPEON; Table = the results table; CapOff hides the caption. The cars park at 16.5 / 25 / 33.5 s (fixed: sonidos\musica.wav is timed to them). The sounds: the sonidos\ folder, one file per sound (see its README.txt). Skyline: what stands behind the LED wall; Tracks = a prefix of track ids ('default' = all the others); Kind costanera | moneda | entel | towers (Count) | track (the track's own models, Count), or Asset = any OBJ model of assets\models (edit them in Blender). X, Z in metres (negative Z = behind the screen, which stands at Z -40), Yaw in radians. AllRaces true = the original game's races too.

Events.Text: {GREET}, Chile! Bienvenidos a la gran final en {TRACK}.
¡Qué ambiente! Vienen llegando los tres mejores de la carrera.
¡{N2} se queda con la plata, a solo {GAP2} segundos!
Señoras y señores... ¡aquí viene el campeón!
¡Los pilotos se bajan de sus vehículos!
Hay lágrimas en las graderías... ¡qué emoción!
¡Chi chi chi, le le le! ¡Viva Chile!
Gracias por acompañarnos. ¡Nos vemos en la próxima carrera!
